skill.title: Make decisions with the empirical rule

steps.ask: Which number of standard deviations either side of the mean holds about 95% of values?
steps.title: Use the Empirical Rule

lines.text: About 95% of values lie within 2 standard deviations of the mean: $\hl{1}{\bar{x}} \pm 2\hl{2}{\sigma}$.

lesson.note: The shaded region is only one standard deviation either side of the mean, not two, so the range is narrower. The same method applies: mean plus or minus the standard deviation.

steps.ask: What are the two ends of the range one standard deviation either side of the mean?
steps.title: Find the boundaries one standard deviation from the mean

lines.text: The shaded area runs from $\hl{1}{\mu} - \hl{2}{\sigma}$ to $\hl{1}{\mu} + \hl{2}{\sigma}$, with $\mu = \hl{1}{480}$ and $\sigma = \hl{2}{90}$.

lesson.note: This time the range is given and you work backwards to the mean and standard deviation. The rule is the same read in reverse: the mean is halfway between the ends, and 2σ is the distance from the mean to either end.

steps.ask: If 95% lies within two standard deviations of the mean, how is the mean related to the two ends of the range?
steps.title: Find the mean

lines.text: By the empirical rule, 95% of values lie within $2\hl{2}{\sigma}$ of the mean, so the range is $\hl{1}{\mu} - 2\hl{2}{\sigma}$ to $\hl{1}{\mu} + 2\hl{2}{\sigma}$.
The mean is halfway between the ends of the range.

steps.ask: Use the top end of the range to find σ. What do you subtract from what?
steps.title: Find the standard deviation

lines.text: The top of the range is $\hl{1}{\mu} + 2\hl{2}{\sigma}$.
$70 = 100 - 2(15)$ and $130 = 100 + 2(15)$, so this is within 2 standard deviations of the mean.
The Empirical Rule says about 95% of values lie within 2 standard deviations.
$85 = 100 - 15$ and $115 = 100 + 15$, so this is within 1 standard deviation of the mean.
The Empirical Rule says about 68% of values lie within 1 standard deviation.

steps.title: Find the interval within one standard deviation

lines.text: Add and subtract the standard deviation from the mean.
So the interval is $[61, 163]$.

steps.title: List the countries outside the interval

lines.text: Meat values below 61 are Macedonia (56) and Poland (54). The value above 163 is Switzerland (254).
About $68\%$ of values lie within one standard deviation of the mean.

steps.ask: Which exact values do sin 30°, cos 30°, sin 45° and cos 45° take?
steps.title: Substitute the exact values

lines.text: $\sin 30^\circ = \frac{1}{2}$, $\cos 30^\circ = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$, $\sin 45^\circ = \cos 45^\circ = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$.
